messages:
Evelyn Park: hi everyone, ev here (joined yesterday). i pushed a tiny fix and the Buildkite job immediately errored with a permissions/checkout issue. not sure if i missed a step in the onboarding checklist. who should i ping?
Buildkite Bot: Build #517 (evelyn/fix-logging) failed · exit code 128 · logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/517
Evelyn Park: checkout log: 
```
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry.git/': The requested URL returned error: 404
```
Samir Rao: welcome! :wave: that 404 usually means the Buildkite GitHub App install doesn't have access to that repo or the repo is private and your user hasn't been granted Actions/pipeline access. Did you accept the org invite?
Evelyn Park: i accepted the invite and added my SSH key. i can clone locally but Buildkite still fails.
Priya Patel: FYI we recently tightened the GitHub App permissions — pipelines use the GitHub Apps checkout when present. If the app is not installed on the repo or the app installation doesn't include members added after the install, you'll see 404/401.
Marta Nguyen: tagging the onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/ci which mentions both org team membership and ensuring the GitHub App is installed on the repo.
Samir Rao: i'm checking the app installs... looks like the telemetry repo was moved into a team-scoped workspace and the app wasn't granted access after migration. i'll add the app and you to the pipeline team.
GitHub Apps Bot: GitHub App "Redwood CI" added to repo redwood-inference/telemetry by Samir Rao
Evelyn Park: re-run now shows a different failure during docker build: 
```
failed to solve: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to copy: http2: server sent GOAWAY and closed the connection
```
Priya Patel: that's a docker registry/edge network flake we saw this morning — sometimes buildx pushes/pulls fail with GOAWAY on our internal registry behind the proxy. Workarounds: 1) set DOCKER_MAX_RETRIES=5 for the job, 2) enable CI_DOCKER_PULL=1 to pull images before build step, or 3) rerun with "Clear caches" which avoids a partial corrupt layer.
Samir Rao: i toggled the registry proxy and manually retried the build with DOCKER_MAX_RETRIES=5 and it progressed further. The job still failed on a test that expects a feature flag enabled in CI: 
```
E AssertionError: expected feature flag onboarding_flow to be true
```
Evelyn Park: ah that might be because i ran a docs-only change but the pipeline still runs the full suite. is there a way to mark PRs as docs-only so it skips heavy tests?
Marta Nguyen: yes, include [ci skip-heavy] in the PR title or add label "docs-only"; our pipeline checks for that and skips integration-heavy stages. onboarding doc has the exact labels to use.
Samir Rao: i added Evelyn to the Buildkite pipeline team and updated the repo app install. Also adjusted the pipeline to be more tolerant of registry GOAWAYs and set DOCKER_MAX_RETRIES default to 3. Please re-run with the docs-only label if appropriate.
Buildkite Bot: Build #518 (evelyn/fix-logging) passed · duration 7m · https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/518
Evelyn Park: thanks all! saved my first-week panic :relieved: quick q: for GitHub Actions in other repos, do i need to request app installs separately?
Priya Patel: typically maintainers or infra add the GitHub App to org repos. If you need it on a repo you don't own, open a short ticket in #eng-infra or ping samir. For editing workflow files you need write access; protected branches may require an approver.
Evelyn Park: perfect. i'll update my onboarding checklist and mark "CI access & GH App" done. thanks everyone!
